artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: rows_for_run(root) rebuilds the induction request FRESH via induction_request.measure_population + induction_request.build_request over the backlog the universe carries UNRESOLVED (never choose_population's RESOLVED_ABSENT branch, never a stored induction_request.json -- proven by test_rows_for_run_wires_measure_population_census_and_build_request). run(rows, as_of, call, stdout) calls ONE ['--folder', folder, '--as-of', as_of, '--write-pool'] per EVIDENCED row via an injected call(argv)->rc (default add_security.main), parses the outcome from add_security's OWN printed-line grammar (already-registered:/REFUSED:/MEASURED:/UNRESOLVED: prefixes), never calls a non-EVIDENCED row, and prints the totals line FIRST and LAST. make_fake_call(rows) is the --dry-run injected fake: records argv, makes no call, scripts registered/already-registered/refused across the first three EVIDENCED rows (every other EVIDENCED row defaults to registered). --fire is refused unless OPAL_INDUCTION_FIRE=1, --as-of names today (UTC), and the process is not under pytest -- fire_permitted() is the pure gate, tested directly; main()'s --fire branch checks it before ever calling library.library_root(), so a refused --fire never reads the OneDrive library. Measured on the real 93-folder library via --dry-run --as-of 2026-09-24 (run twice, identical both times): population 60 evidenced 21 ambiguous 2 (Copa CPA, Uber Technologies UBER US, both existing security_key collisions) other 37 called 21 registered 19 already_registered 1 refused 1 errors 0 bloomberg_calls 0 sum 60.

12 tests, offline, under tests/conftest.py's autouse poison (boto3.client/resource/Session.client, subprocess.run/Popen, socket.create_connection) plus an explicit save/restore positive control on add_security._load_blp_client (the one site conftest does not cover): (1) rows_for_run's wiring (measure_population(root) -> census-derived entries_by_folder + the UNRESOLVED folders, never resolved_absent, into build_request); (2) run() calling only EVIDENCED rows and parsing every outcome branch (registered/already-registered/refused/unresolved/error) from a hand-scripted call reproducing add_security's own printed-line grammar, with totals math (E+A+O=P, called=evidenced) and totals-FIRST-and-LAST asserted by exact string count/ordering; (3) make_fake_call scripting every branch (registered/already-registered/refused) across 4 EVIDENCED rows with bloomberg_calls 0 and argv recorded; (4) the add_security._load_blp_client poison positive control (raises, counts, resets); (5) fire_permitted's four gate combinations (env+today+outside-pytest=True; missing env=False; non-today as-of=False; inside-pytest=False even with env+today); (6) main()'s --fire refusal end-to-end without the env var, with the env var set (still refused, running under pytest), and with a non-today as-of, plus --as-of format validation (rc 2) -- none of these six touch library.library_root() since the refusal/validation returns before it.

The AC2 dry-run read-back JSON: as_of, the 11 totals fields, and one row per population folder (folder, state, called, rc, outcome, security_key|reason, bloomberg_calls). Written only under this worker's own deliverables dir, nowhere under lib/research/identity/.
